items.title: Tech stocks today: Uber cuts 3,300 roles, implements stricter remote work policy
items.summary: Tech stocks were muted as Uber announced layoffs and Dell earnings impressed.

items.title: Lucid’s CEO Promised a $1.4 Billion Turnaround, Then This Happened
items.summary: Lucid's new CEO launched a sweeping turnaround plan and called out years of failure in unusually blunt terms, yet the stock hit a 52-week low days later. Something in that reset spooked investors far more than it reassured them.

items.title: Delivery Hero board backs Uber $14.8 billion takeover bid
items.summary: The German food delivery company's management and supervisory boards independently reviewed the offer and advised shareholders to accept it

items.title: Credo, Dell, Palo Alto, PG&E, Uber, MongoDB, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Dell’s second-quarter earnings top expectations thanks to the AI boom, but Palo Alto Networks tumbles as investors take profits.

items.title: Dara Khosrowshahi Cut 3,400 Jobs, but Swears It’s Not AI.
items.summary: Uber’s chief framed Wednesday’s 10% workforce reduction as making the ride share company “simpler and faster,” as margins have climbed since 2023.

items.title: Uber’s $15 Billion Takeover Bid Gets Delivery Hero Board Backing
items.summary: The German delivery company said its management and supervisory boards had independently reviewed the U.S. giant’s offer.

items.title: Uber says laying off 'about 10%' of workforce worldwide
items.summary: Ride-hailing giant Uber will be laying off around 10 percent of its staff as part of "significant organizational changes," CEO Dara Khosrowshahi said in a message to employees released on Wednesday."Today, we're making a number of significant organizational changes across Uber," Khosrowshahi said.
